identity.fantasy: A bow-and-voodoo hunter who reclaims Spirits through arrows, then spends them on eclipses, glaives, wards, and frenzied summons.
identity.one_line: A bow-and-voodoo hunter who reclaims Spirits through arrows, then spends them on eclipses, glaives, wards, and frenzied summons. The defining decision is contextual: Movement pressure and Spirit level continually change offense versus sustain choices.

mechanics.core_loop: A mobile bow-and-voodoo hybrid that collects Spirits through Reclamation and Malefic Arrow, then spends them on Spirit Eclipse, glaives, wards, or Frenzied Spirits. It combines sustained ranged damage, self-healing, summons, and burst, but asks the player to juggle two damage scalings and a Spirit cycle.
mechanics.single_target: Generate Spirits with Reclamation and Malefic Arrow, kite while moving, then spend into Spirit Eclipse, Frenzied Spirits, glaives, or wards. Sources describe the transition but do not provide an exact late-game priority.
mechanics.aoe: Slows, wards, summons, and Spirit spenders support kited packs. Players report that Mimic improves the experience later, while early levels feel button-heavy and fragile.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Mobile bow attacks, wards, and kiting tools make it active at range.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Malefic Arrow, Reclamation, Spirit Glaive, Mojo High, Call of Sseratus.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Darkspear Traditionalist, Strength of Da Loa, Spirit Shock, A Price To Pay.

failure_modes.text: Overspending Spirits before Eclipse or summon windows, failing to kite, or splitting physical and spell scaling poorly can leave the hybrid without pressure or sustain.
Standing still to force damage instead of using moving Reclamation and slows removes the survival pattern reported by levelers.
Building only one side of the hybrid's physical and spell scaling can leave Spirit spenders or bow pressure under-supported.

strengths: A bow-and-voodoo hunter who reclaims Spirits through arrows, then spends them on eclipses, glaives, wards, and frenzied summons.

cautions: Early leveling receives sharp criticism while mid-40s play receives praise, making level band more important than a single verdict.
